item.title: Yumemi Hakusho
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: H-do-C
  • 発売日: 2008-06-27
  • スコア: 6.75/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夢見白書
  • 英語名: Yumemi Hakusho

别名

  • Dream Watchers Notebook

あらすじ

Yuuto Yumekawa was about to confess his feelings to his childhood friend, Tamaki Amanogawa. However, even though he wanted to take her out to the park for the confession, he couldn’t, and quickly ran off after fabricating a story.

And then, it happened.

On her way home from the park, Tamaki got in a car accident and passed away.

item.title: Nettai Teikiatsu Shoujo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: H-do-C
  • 発売日: 2007-10-25
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 熱帯低気圧少女
  • 英語名: Nettai Teikiatsu Shoujo

别名

  • Tropical Low Atmosphere Girl

あらすじ

Takashi is a high school student, who wants to become a weather forecaster. He enjoys his school life surrounded by unique friends and classmates. But one day, a girl, Tomoe, transfers to his class and various troubles happen after she comes. Takashi thinks Tomoe is concerned with these phenomena. A while later, a big typhoon appears and comes closer to his town. Will they be able to survive…?

item.title: Yumemishi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: H-do-C
  • 発売日: 2006-12-28
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (33 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夢見師
  • 英語名: Yumemishi

あらすじ

Hirou lives with his grandmother, Tose. One day, he notices the things happened yesterday are happening again. It seems he lives the same day twice. The most beautiful girl at his school, Natsuko. A cheerful girl, Nao. And a mysterious girl, Sakuya. As a day rolls on, they gradually become important to him….

[From Himeya Shop]
